about.title: Chico Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing someone suddenly leaves a family in Chico with questions that have nothing to do with paperwork, yet paperwork arrives anyway. A wrongful death claim is the civil path California gives certain family members to hold a negligent party financially accountable. It stands apart from any criminal case; a prosecutor's decision in Butte County does not open or close your door to a civil claim. In 2025, Chico recorded 3 traffic deaths alongside 209 injury collisions, with public records showing the heaviest crash volumes along Esplanade, SR-99, Cohasset Road and East Avenue. Fatal losses also arise away from the road, in workplaces, care settings and on someone else's property. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters and works on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. You share what happened once, and we help you reach someone who can review standing, deadlines and the losses your household may recover.

items.title: Clarity on who may bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you're connected with can sort out who in your family qualifies before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines tracked from day one
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. Early attorney contact keeps those dates from slipping.

items.title: Recovery that reflects the whole loss
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. An independent attorney on contingency pursues each category with no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: My relative died in a crash on SR-99 outside Chico and the CHP hasn't finished its report. Can we still start a claim?
items.answer: Yes. The collision report matters as evidence, but a wrongful death claim does not wait on it, and the two-year clock runs from the date of death regardless. An attorney can begin preserving evidence and identifying responsible parties while the report is pending. If a public agency is potentially at fault, the notice deadline is much shorter, so it helps to ask sooner rather than later.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges in Butte County. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action that proceeds separately from any criminal prosecution. The criminal case is about punishment; the civil case is about compensating your family for what was lost. An acquittal or a dropped charge does not by itself prevent a civil claim.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything, and who actually handles the case?
items.answer: LawProactive is free to use and is not a law firm. We connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters and works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery. You are never obligated to hire anyone we introduce.
